New. Upstream ships no tests, no CI and no CPU path, so nothing could be validated against this repository alone. Parameterised over all 14 variants plus the cross-variant image-equality oracle.

covered.evidence: Built for gfx942 on an AMD Instinct MI300X (ROCm 7.14, torch 2.14) via torch build-time hipify, zero compiler warnings and no register-spill diagnostic. Imports and exports rasterize_gaussians, rasterize_gaussians_backward and mark_visible; renders a 4000-surfel scene whose first three channels agree with the base variant to rtol 1e-4, is bit-identical run to run, and whose opacity gradient matches a central finite difference (slope 0.979). Kernels confirmed dispatching on the AMD device under AMD_LOG_LEVEL=3.

Added as tests/test_variants.py with tests/README.md. 95 passed, 5 skipped on linux-gfx942 (python -m pytest tests/test_variants.py -q, 7.38 s); the skips are the four per-variant checks the 1x1-tile variant is too slow to run at 200x150 plus the base variant compared against itself.

scoped_out.reason: The per-variant CMakeLists.txt static-library dev path is dead as shipped, on CUDA as well as ROCm: target_include_directories points PRIVATE at <variant>/third_party/glm, which contains only stbi_image_write.h, and the per-variant .gitmodules declaring that submodule registers no gitlink (git submodule status lists only the repository-root third_party/glm). Nothing consumes it -- every consumer, including EnvGS, builds the torch extension via setup.py. Porting it would mean first fixing an upstream build break. Registered as a deferral so it is reviewed with this port.
